item.text: I have the shape of the refactor: a small controller will own event wiring, `Simulator` will become pure model/orchestration, and `SimulatorView` will render a snapshot instead of reaching back into the simulator. I’m applying that split now.
The split is in place. I’m validating for any stale simulator/view references now, because the first pass through a boundary refactor usually leaves a small number of compile errors behind.
I’ve finished the code split and am running the build now to catch any interface mismatches, stale imports, or constructor issues introduced by the new controller/snapshot layer.
The build is green. I’m pulling exact line numbers for the changed boundary so I can summarize the refactor with concrete file references instead of hand-waving.

Separated the simulator orchestration from the Swing UI.

What changed:
- `Simulator` no longer owns a view or performs UI updates. It now only advances state, resets, infects, and exposes `isViable()` plus `createSnapshot()`. See [`Simulator.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Simulator.java#L85) and [`Simulator.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Simulator.java#L261).
- Added a small controller layer, `SimulatorController`, to coordinate button events and trigger view refreshes after each simulator action. See [`SimulatorController.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SimulatorController.java#L11).
- `SimulatorView` no longer calls into `Simulator`. It now receives a `SimulationActions` callback interface for UI events and renders a `SimulationSnapshot` instead of pulling state directly from the model. See [`SimulatorView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SimulatorView.java#L50) and [`SimulatorView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SimulatorView.java#L173).
- Added `SimulationSnapshot` as the handoff object between model/controller and view. See [`SimulationSnapshot.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/SimulationSnapshot.java#L6).
- `Main` now boots the controller instead of instantiating the simulator directly. See [`Main.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/src/main/java/safari/Main.java#L12).
